headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all body text, labels, and UI elements.

spacing.philosophy: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.

goals_list.style: Card-based, minimal info, progress bar prominent

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-glow rounded-full font-bold tracking-wide uppercase text-xs px-6 py-3 transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full font-medium text-xs px-6 py-3

cards.base: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors

inputs.base: bg-surface_highlight border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-lg h-12 px-4 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50

textures.usage: Subtle overlay on Dashboard Hero Card (opacity 10%, mix-blend-overlay)

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent sizing (w-5 h-5).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Replace the existing colors in tailwind.config.js with the 'Cyber-Zen' palette defined above. Use CSS variables in index.css for dynamic theme support if needed, or hardcode in config for simplicity given 'Dark Mode Only' constraint.
2. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import link to public/index.html or import in index.css.
3. CREATE LAYOUT: Build the 'Dashboard' using the Bento Grid strategy. Use 'framer-motion' for entrance animations.
4. CUSTOMIZE SHADCN: Override default Shadcn styles (radius, colors) to match the design system. Specifically, make buttons 'pill-shaped' (rounded-full) and inputs taller (h-12).
5. IMPLEMENT FEATURES: Build the Goal Tracking, Milestones, and Habits logic using local state or a simple mock backend context if actual backend isn't ready.
6. USE TEXTURE: Apply the provided Unsplash texture URL as a background image for the main 'Hero' card on the dashboard to give it depth.
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA/WCAG).
Avoid 'Inter' font; use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' and 'Chivo'.
Make sure the app feels 'premium' and 'focused'.
